hero.name: Lukas Schönmann
hero.summary: Working at the intersection of computational biology and data science. Focused on large-scale genomic analysis, high-performance computing, and building reproducible pipelines with Python, R, and modern tooling.

cv.heading: Curriculum Vitae
cv.description: A summary of my professional experience, education, and technical skills.

experience.title: Research Associate (Computational Biology/Bioinformatics)
experience.description: Large-scale genomic data analysis (NGS, k-mer-based GWAS, variant calling) with reproducible pipelines on HPC clusters; developing bioinformatics tools, writing scientific manuscripts and student supervision.

experience.title: E-Multiplicator
experience.description: Advised instructors on online-supported teaching and enhanced the university e-learning platform (BOKUExams) with automated question generation and new practice exercises.

experience.title: Student Assistant, Institute of Computational Biology
experience.description: Supported computational biology teaching and research activities, contributing to data processing workflows and student guidance.

experience.title: Tutor, Institute of Statistics
experience.description: Tutor for the courses 'First Steps with R' and 'Statistics with R'.

experience.title: Tutor, Organic Chemistry Practicals
experience.description: Led practical lab sessions covering liquid-liquid extraction, distillation, recrystallization, thin layer chromatography, and synthesis.

experience.title: Internship Lab Technician QM
experience.description: Conducted cereal chemistry analyses for raw material quality control, performed malt analytics (EBC, Kjeldahl, MEBAK), and supported audits.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science - BSc, Food Science and Biotechnology

skills.name: Python
skills.description: Extensive experience in Python for data analysis, scripting, and developing bioinformatics tools.

skills.name: R
skills.description: Proficient in R for statistical analysis, data visualization, and building interactive reports.

skills.name: Bash
skills.description: Proficient in Bash scripting for automating tasks and managing system operations in a Linux environment.

skills.name: Data Handling & Analysis
skills.description: Efficient reading, transformation, and analysis of larger datasets using Polars, Pandas, and R (tidyverse). Basic experience with SQL (PostgreSQL) and accessing external data sources via REST APIs.

skills.name: Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)
skills.description: Hands-on experience with NGS data analysis, including quality control, alignment, and variant calling.

skills.name: Machine learning (scikit-learn)
skills.description: Applied machine learning techniques for predictive modeling and data-driven insights in biological datasets, such as Random Forests.

skills.name: Data visualization (Jupyter, Rmarkdown)
skills.description: Creating compelling data visualizations and reports to communicate complex findings effectively, using matplotlib, ggplot2, seaborn, and plotly graph libraries, and dimensionality reduction techniques such as PCA and UMAP.

skills.name: GWAS & variant analysis
skills.description: Specialized in k-mer based genome-wide association studies and (structural) variant analysis for genomic research.

skills.name: Bioinformatics pipelines (Snakemake)
skills.description: Building and managing reproducible bioinformatics pipelines for automated data processing and analysis.

skills.name: Rust tooling & CI/CD
skills.description: Utilizing Rust for performance-critical applications and implementing CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.

skills.name: High-performance computing (HPC)
skills.description: Working with terabyte-scale data on a high-performance Linux cluster and the Austrian Scientific Computing cluster, submitting SLURM scripts, and utilizing parallelization.

skills.name: Dependency management (conda/uv)
skills.description: Managing Python environments and packages with conda and uv, including creating, activating, and installing dependencies.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.description: A selection of personal and professional projects I've worked on.

items.title: MerKurio
items.description: A bioinformatics command-line tool written in Rust for quick k-mer-based FASTA/FASTQ sequence record extraction, and SAM/BAM record filtering plus file annotation with k-mer tags.

items.title: Portfolio Website
items.description: Personal portfolio website designed and implemented in React/TypeScript. Rapidly prototyped and iteratively refined using AI-assisted development workflows (LLM-based code generation and review), with manual validation and refactoring.
